prompt: Diels-Alder: 1,3-butadiene + methyl vinyl ketone (CH₂=CH-COCH₃), heat. Draw the Diels-Alder adduct.
explanation: The EWG (acetyl) activates the dienophile by lowering its LUMO. The product is a cyclohexene with the acetyl group adjacent to the new ring (ortho/para to the double bond in the ring).
